open_ring: Session menu (physical click, retry-until-popup-has-item) -> Session Settings... -> TSessionDialog 599x602; 4 TUiSpecComboBox top-order Left/Right/Center/Output; TUiOkBtn/TUiCancelBtn.
commit_rule: set_edit_text writes the visible field (UIA Edit read-back may lag; dialog pixel diff confirms); TAB commits the combo VALUE pattern (read-back then returns the new path); element wrappers go STALE after TAB -> re-acquire the dialog wrapper before touching buttons.

ok_ring.invoke_effective: uia invoke IS effective on TUiOkBtn (dialog button family) — NOT the toolbar TUiSpeedButton invoke-ineffective family; do not extrapolate.
ok_ring.confirm_modal: OK raises a MODAL TFileConfirmSaveDialog 'Save merge output?' (Yes/No/Cancel) whenever the current merge output document differs from the on-disk target (probe never hand-edited the output, yet it prompted -> BC treats dirty = merged-result != target-bytes, not just user edits). Cancel on the Settings dialog does NOT raise it.
ok_ring.yes: Yes writes the PRE-application (old-spec) merged document to the target file (out-after = LEFT-ONE-ORIGINAL..., the old take-left result, NOT left2's), THEN applies the new spec.
ok_ring.no: No skips the write (out stays PRESETPANE_OUT), then applies + re-compares.
ok_ring.both_recompare_in_place: after Yes or No the source panes RE-COMPARE with main TViewForm handle UNCHANGED (main-replaced=false, left-pane pixel diff 611 = L->left2 took effect); title stays '{out} - Text Merge' (does NOT track the new Left path).
ok_ring.cancel: Cancel closes the Settings dialog with ZERO side effects: no confirm, no re-compare (leftpane diff 0), output file untouched, spec edits discarded.
ok_ring.stacking_lesson: while the confirm modal is up, TSessionDialog still reports visible — the earlier 'OK did nothing' readings were this stack (four input routes fired while the modal swallowed them); dialog rings must be walked modal-by-modal, window-present != interactable.
